# Okeyo Travel
> AI-powered travel planning and lodging in Morocco. Curated riads, lodges
> and authentic experiences in Marrakech, Essaouira, Chefchaouen, Ourika,
> Ouirgane, Atlas, and the Sahara desert.

## Main entry points
- [Home](https://okeyotravel.com/en): AI Morocco trip planning
- [Explore](https://okeyotravel.com/en/explore): 26 curated stays
- [Blog](https://okeyotravel.com/fr/blog): Morocco travel guides

## Featured destinations
- Marrakech (riads, kasbah, medina)
- Essaouira (coast, riad)
- Chefchaouen (blue city)
- Ourika & Ouirgane (Atlas mountains)
- Merzouga (Sahara desert)

## Property types
- Riad · Auberge · Maison d'hôtes · Kasbah · Lodge

## Languages
- French (primary) · English · Arabic
